beats.title: Sonic walks up to the microphone as the graduates settle

beats.text: Ok.. so... *taps mic*
I've gotta say, receiving this degree has been a big honour
but the bad thing is, we have to go to college now!
Man... this high school's been a pain! Now college?
Oh jeez.. I wonder if our teachers there won't be as bad as Egghead
but.. it's not really all about learning
It's about friendship, even your fangirls!
but most importantly.. it's the people you love that remain in your heart
Aaaawww
So what if this degree is getting me out of here to a new journey of life
What about my three best buddies? One of them is like a brother to me
the other one is like my side kick!
and we all know, that the last one is the faker
Oh, wait! I almost forgot! My fangirls!
and I haven't forgotten about you, Rouge
Another thing, I know I hardly pay attention in class
but there's that time where I heard 'Keep your friends close, but enemies closer'
and I'm just sat there like 'Why the enemies?'
but you all remember when I had a massive fight with some certain guy
Who kinda did a lot of crimes...
but when I was finally gonna win the fight.. I realised that the quote.. was meant for me and him..
and that's why I stood in front of him.. almost sacrificing my life for him.. cause he's my friend
and at last.. the love of my life..
I know you're out there in the crowds somewhere...
but.. you remember the time when we first met?
That was the best thing that ever happened to me in my life
It's like.. you were supposed to be here.. for me
It's like a gift from the Angels!
I never fell for you cause you're beautiful
I fell for you.. cause of your heart
but.. I'm just scared, I don't wanna lose any of you..
No matter what, we will all stay forever united!
and I will NEVER.. let us be apart.. Ames...
SO LET'S ALL BE HAPPY CAUSE WE'VE DID IT!

beats.title: The whole class sings together at graduation
Sonic and Amy sing about the future they have started
Everyone celebrates where they come from
Tails, Rouge and the whole gang remember the best of times
Knuckles and Tikal, Manic and Sally, Silver and Blaze hold on to each other
The friends who have been there all along sing together
The world is one big stage and the show will never close
The whole school sings the final chorus together
Everyone cheers as high school lives on forever
